title: Training zone setting
description: A versioned heart-rate, pace, or power zone configuration.

sportType.description: The sport type to which the zones apply.

zoneType.description: The measurement domain used by the zones.

benchmark.description: The benchmark value or stable benchmark type used to calculate the zones.

provider.description: The external provider that supplied the zone configuration, when available.

zones.description: The ordered zone definitions from the lowest to the highest intensity.

items.description: A zone definition including its label and boundaries.

effectiveFrom.description: The start of the configuration validity period in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The time the configuration was created in ISO 8601 format.

source.description: The system or user action that originally supplied this record.

sourceExternalId.description: The stable record identifier assigned by the source system, when available.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: The last modification time reported by the source system in ISO 8601 format.
